title: Demo reminder mutations leave the vacancy-detail header counts stale (no detail refetch after ApiReturnedReminder/ApiReturnedApplicantReminder)
detail: The diff makes awaiting_count/remindable_count/followup_count derive from the mutated store (demo_store.gleam:887-899), but the success handlers only refetch the awaiting list; model.vacancy_detail keeps pre-mutation counts. vacancy_detail.gleam:127-133 renders the reminder button counts from that stale detail. The real flow has identical staleness (parity), so this is a note, not a divergence.
recommended_fix: After a successful reminder in demo mode, also refetch the vacancy detail from the store (or accept parity with the real flow and pin the stale-until-reload behavior in a test).
